title: BirdWeather Station Migration Peak Day
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=birdweather:station
bin _time span=1d
stats sum(detection_count) as detections by _time
sort - detections
description: Identifies peak migration detection days on BirdWeather stations.
value: Surfacing birdweather station migration peak day helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant wildlife & biodiversity export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up when birdweather station migration peak day matters for your routine.
